topic: Text Generation: A Systematic Literature Review of Tasks, Evaluation, and Challenges
topic_definition: Stage 1 observable projection of the original paper's eligibility. Use title and abstract evidence to judge whether the study is relevant to text generation or natural language generation, including generation tasks, methods, datasets, evaluation, challenges, or limitations.
summary: Stage 1 title/abstract projection of source-faithful Stage 2 criteria; publication-time filtering is handled by cutoff_jsons/2405.15604.json.

summary_topics.description: Text Generation: A Systematic Literature Review of Tasks, Evaluation, and Challenges

required.criterion: Title/abstract clearly signals text generation, natural language generation, machine-generated text, or a recognized text-generation task.
Observable contribution can be reviewed for text-generation methods, tasks, applications, datasets, evaluation, challenges, or limitations.
When text-generation relevance is plausible but the exact task or scope is incomplete in title/abstract, keep maybe and defer final confirmation to Stage 2.

exclusion_criteria.criterion: Title/abstract clearly indicates non-generation NLP or work outside the text-generation scope.
Title/abstract clearly indicates multimodal-only generation or another overly specific scope outside the review's text-generation focus.
Title/abstract clearly indicates the work mainly applies generation to another field, such as medicine or a narrow clinical domain, rather than studying text generation itself.
